CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION safebus_private.has_recent_authentication()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'safebus_private', 'auth', 'extensions', 'realtime', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from auth.users u
    where u.id = auth.uid()
      and u.last_sign_in_at is not null
      and u.last_sign_in_at >= now() - make_interval(secs => safebus_private.recent_auth_window_seconds())
  );
$function$
